stemMd: One well-documented exception was enough to ______ the claim that the process always yields identical results.
explanationMd: A universal statement using always is false if one genuine counterexample exists. Refute captures that logical force; many ordinary statistical claims would require a different standard.

distractorRationale.a: A single exception challenges the validity of the universal assertion; it does not measure its magnitude or frequency.
distractorRationale.c: A counterexample undermines rather than supports it.
distractorRationale.e: The exception does not repeat the claim.
distractorRationale.d: An exception does not exemplify the universal claim.
